question: Who released the book 'Chunautiyan Mujhe Pasand Hai'?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Jagdeep Dhankhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Dhankhar releases book on UP Governor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The book titled **'Chunautiyan Mujhe Pasand Hai'** translates to **'I Like Challenges'**.

 
 
• 
 
It was released by **Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar**.

 
 
• 
 
The book chronicles the journey of **Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel**.

 
 
• 
 
The release event was held at **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University in Lucknow**.

 
 
• 
 
The book highlights **Anandiben Patel's rise from humble beginnings to high public office**.

 
 
• 
 
Authors of the book are **Vinay Joshi**, **Ashok Desai**, and **Pankaj Jani**.
